# Game Idea: Neon Light Runner

**Genre:** Endless runner (side‑scroll) on an HTML canvas.

**Core Loop:**
- The player controls a glowing neon ship that continuously moves forward.
- Tap / click to make the ship jump or ascend; release to descend.
- Randomly generated obstacles (spikes, lasers) appear from the right.
- Collect glowing orbs to boost a visual "energy" meter.

**Lose Condition:**
- The ship collides with an obstacle **or** the energy meter depletes to zero.

**Win Condition (optional):**
- Achieve a high score based on distance and orbs collected.

**Why it works on Canvas:**
- Simple 2‑D shapes and sprite drawing.
- Uses requestAnimationFrame for smooth animation.
- Collision detection via bounding boxes.

1: // Neon Light Runner – minimal implementation
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
10: 
11:   // Sound effects (tiny wav data URIs)
12:   const jumpSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABCxAgAEABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
13:   const collectSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABCxAgAEABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
14:   const hitSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABCxAgAEABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
15: 
16:   // Game state
17:   let score = 0;
18:   let energy = 1; // 0‑1 range
19:   let lastTime = 0;
20:   const ship = {x: 80, y: H/2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0, gravity: 0.4, jump: -8};
21:   const obstacles = [];
22:   const orbs = [];
23: 
24:   // Input – tap / click to ascend
25:   const onPress = () => { ship.vy = ship.jump; jumpSound.play(); };
26:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onPress);
27:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onPress);
28: 
29:   // Helper functions
30:   const rectCollide = (a,b) => a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
31:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
32:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
33:     obstacles.push({x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size, speed: 4 + Math.random()*2});
34:   };
35:   const spawnOrb = () => {
36:     const r = 8;
37:     const y = Math.random() * (H - 2*r) + r;
38:     orbs.push({x: W, y, r, speed: 3});
39:   };
40: 
41:   // Main loop
42:   function update(dt) {
43:     // Ship physics
44:     ship.vy += ship.gravity;
45:     ship.y += ship.vy;
46:     if (ship.y + ship.h > H) { ship.y = H - ship.h; ship.vy = 0; }
47:     if (ship.y < 0) { ship.y = 0; ship.vy = 0; }
48: 
49:     // Move obstacles & orbs
50:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
51:     orbs.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
52:     // Remove off‑screen
53:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
54:     while (orbs.length && orbs[0].x + orbs[0].r < 0) orbs.shift();
55: 
56:     // Spawn logic
57:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnObstacle();
58:     if (Math.random() < 0.015) spawnOrb();
59: 
60:     // Collision detection
61:     for (const o of obstacles) {
62:       if (rectCollide(ship, o)) { energy = 0; hitSound.play(); }
63:     }
64:     for (let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
65:       const orb = orbs[i];
66:       const dx = (ship.x + ship.w/2) - orb.x;
67:       const dy = (ship.y + ship.h/2) - orb.y;
68:         if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (orb.r+10)*(orb.r+10)) { // collect
69:           orbs.splice(i,1);
70:           energy = Math.min(1, energy + 0.1);
71:           score += 10;
72:           collectSound.play();
73:         }
74:     }
75:     // Energy drain
76:     energy -= dt * 0.0002;
77:     if (energy <= 0) { // Game over – reset
78:       alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
79:       score = 0; energy = 1; ship.y = H/2; ship.vy = 0; obstacles.length = 0; orbs.length = 0;
80:     }
81:     score += dt * 0.01;
82:   }
83: 
84:   function draw() {
85:     // Background gradient (dark to deep blue)
86:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
87:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
88:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
89:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
90:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
91: 
92:     // Neon ship – triangle with glow
93:     ctx.save();
94:     ctx.translate(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
96:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
97:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.w / 2, ship.h / 2);
100:     ctx.lineTo(ship.w / 2, ship.h / 2);
101:     ctx.lineTo(0, -ship.h / 2);
102:     ctx.closePath();
103:     ctx.fill();
104:     ctx.restore();
105: 
106:     // Obstacles – spikes with neon red glow
107:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f44';
108:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
110:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
111:       ctx.save();
112:       ctx.translate(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2);
113:       ctx.beginPath();
114:       ctx.moveTo(-o.w / 2, o.h / 2);
115:       ctx.lineTo(o.w / 2, o.h / 2);
116:       ctx.lineTo(0, -o.h / 2);
117:       ctx.closePath();
118:       ctx.fill();
119:       ctx.restore();
120:     });
121:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset blur for orbs
122: 
123:     // Orbs – glowing yellow circles with radial gradient
124:     orbs.forEach(o => {
125:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r);
126:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
127:       grad.addColorStop(0.6, '#ff0');
128:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
129:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     });
134:     // UI – score & energy bar
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
136:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
137:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
139:     ctx.fillRect(10, 30, energy*100, 10);
140:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
141:     ctx.strokeRect(10,30,100,10);
142:   }
143: 
144:   function loop(timestamp) {
145:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
146:     lastTime = timestamp;
147:     update(dt);
148:     draw();
149:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
150:   }
151:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152: })();

(End of file - total 152 lines)
</content>
